rules.rule: Display workspace, role, affected users, scope, save model, billing impact, permission impact, dependency warning, and reversibility beside every administrative save or team-impacting action.
rules.rationale: Decision context must be visible at the moment of commitment.
rules.failureMode: Missing context causes changing settings in a personal workspace thinking it is the team workspace.

rules.rule: Show affected users count in the same visual group as the primary action.
rules.rationale: The highest-risk identifier must travel with the action.
rules.failureMode: The user acts without seeing affected users count.

rules.rule: Label data freshness or status whenever the view contains tables, filters, settings, audit logs, permissions, and operational dashboards.
rules.rationale: Users must know whether operational data is current.
rules.failureMode: The interface hides stale context around tables, filters, settings, audit logs, permissions, and operational dashboards.

rules.rule: Require a review step before workspace setting change, invite, export, integration change, shared configuration delete, and role update.
rules.rationale: High-cost actions need an interruption for verification.
rules.failureMode: The user completes workspace setting change, invite, export, integration change, shared configuration delete, and role update without review.

rules.rule: Block silent changes to critical values after review in administrative save or team-impacting action.
rules.rationale: Consent depends on the reviewed values staying stable.
rules.failureMode: The UI allows changing settings in a personal workspace thinking it is the team workspace.

rules.rule: Provide a recovery or correction path when changing settings in a personal workspace thinking it is the team workspace.
rules.rationale: High-cost mistakes need visible next steps.
rules.failureMode: The user cannot recover after changing settings in a personal workspace thinking it is the team workspace.

rules.rule: Match density to tables, filters, settings, audit logs, permissions, and operational dashboards; do not use decorative spacing that separates labels from values.
rules.rationale: Domain work depends on scanning related facts together.
rules.failureMode: Related labels and values drift apart visually.

rules.rule: Keep required identifiers visible at mobile widths for administrative save or team-impacting action.
rules.rationale: Narrow screens are common at decision time.
rules.failureMode: Mobile layout hides affected users count.

rules.rule: Do not use decorative motion around settings, dashboards, editors, tables, or admin forms.
rules.rationale: Motion must not hide or trivialize domain state.
rules.failureMode: Motion obscures changing settings in a personal workspace thinking it is the team workspace.

rules.rule: Provide a reduced-motion path for status changes involving workspace-switch, permission-denied, unsaved-changes, save-conflict, integration-disconnected, plan-limit, audit-log-unavailable, and empty-team.
rules.rationale: State meaning must survive user motion preferences.

rules.rule: Use exact labels for workspace, organization, team, personal scope, role, permission, seat limit, audit log, and data scope.
rules.rationale: Precise terms map to different user decisions.
rules.failureMode: A vague label masks changing settings in a personal workspace thinking it is the team workspace.

rules.rule: Do not use color alone to distinguish workspace-switch, permission-denied, unsaved-changes, save-conflict, integration-disconnected, plan-limit, audit-log-unavailable, and empty-team.
rules.rationale: Status must be perceivable without color vision.
rules.failureMode: Users miss a state among workspace-switch, permission-denied, unsaved-changes, save-conflict, integration-disconnected, plan-limit, audit-log-unavailable, and empty-team.

rules.rule: Provide states for workspace-switch, permission-denied, unsaved-changes, save-conflict, integration-disconnected, plan-limit, audit-log-unavailable, and empty-team.
rules.rationale: Domain flows contain more than loading/success/error.
rules.failureMode: A missing state causes changing settings in a personal workspace thinking it is the team workspace.

rules.rule: Use exact labels for workspace, organization, team, personal scope, role, permission, seat limit, audit log, and data scope.
rules.failureMode: A generic label causes changing settings in a personal workspace thinking it is the team workspace.

rules.rule: Define ambiguous values as personal workspace, team workspace, autosaved, unsaved, permission denied, plan limit, and audit unavailable.
rules.rationale: Users should not infer whether values are final or provisional.
rules.failureMode: A provisional value is treated as final in administrative save or team-impacting action.

rules.rule: Provide states for workspace-switch, permission-denied, unsaved-changes, save-conflict, integration-disconnected, plan-limit, audit-log-unavailable, and empty-team.
rules.rationale: Domain flows contain more than loading/success/error.
rules.failureMode: A missing state causes changing settings in a personal workspace thinking it is the team workspace.

rules.rule: Preserve user input or task context when recovery is needed after administrative save or team-impacting action.
rules.rationale: Recovery without preserved context still fails the task.
rules.failureMode: The user must restart after changing settings in a personal workspace thinking it is the team workspace.

rules.rule: Expose an empty or unavailable state that explains whether tables, filters, settings, audit logs, permissions, and operational dashboards are absent, filtered, stale, or permission denied.
rules.rationale: Empty states need cause and next action.
rules.failureMode: Users cannot distinguish absent data from hidden data.

rules.rule: Keep affected users count visible in confirmation and receipt states.
rules.rationale: Receipts are evidence and recovery anchors.
rules.failureMode: The confirmation omits affected users count.
